name: Jellyseerr Bridge
overview: Jellyseerr inside Jellyfin: button, embedded view, search and sign-in.
description: Brings Jellyseerr into the Jellyfin web client: a button in the header and side menu, Jellyseerr embedded in Jellyfin instead of a redirect, Jellyseerr suggestions under Jellyfin search results with one-click requests attributed to the right user, optional single sign-on via Quick Connect, and a compatibility bridge for clients that still send legacy X-Emby authorization headers. Settings page is in German; the button label follows each user's language.

versions.changelog: Header and side-menu button, embedded view, search suggestions with requests, single sign-on via Quick Connect, legacy auth header bridge.

name: MKI Merge Versions
overview: Two resolutions, one entry. The 4K version leads.
description: Merges movies that exist in several resolutions into a single library entry, matched by TMDb ID (IMDb as fallback), never by title. The highest resolution becomes the primary version. Runs as a scheduled task and automatically once the library has been quiet for five minutes. Includes a dry-run mode. Settings page is in German.

versions.changelog: First release: links versions via the database, groups by TMDb/IMDb, highest resolution becomes primary, own settings page.

name: Media Hero
overview: A cinematic hero banner on the Jellyfin home screen.
description: Adds a full-width hero carousel to the Jellyfin home screen. The list is prepared on the server from recently added, top rated and (optionally) Jellyseerr trending titles, filtered per library with title, genre, tag and rating whitelists and blacklists. Layout, transitions, text and buttons are configurable. Settings page is in German.

versions.changelog: Per-library targets, sources as upper limits, paged Jellyseerr trending lookup, browser caching and a background pre-warmer.
